status: throwaway 3D kitbash spike; no game integration
rest_pose_export: Captured neutral local TRS restored after Blender 4.3 NLA export; animation buffers are unchanged.
rig: named rigid-part pivots with NLA-exported glTF animation

clips.name: Idle
clips.purpose: slow body inflation and jaw breathing

clips.purpose: inhale, mouth open, crouch, hop, heavy landing

source_mesh_policy: Every exported model triangle is copied from a selected donor mesh. No primitive mesh is added to the model; donor topology is retained and affine-transformed. Render floor/lights/camera are excluded.

donor_credits.name: Furnace Beetle
donor_credits.credits: Original authored low-poly concept model from the Flying Monsters 3D Gallery. Supplied reference sheets are not shipped.

donor_credits.name: Shelf Buddies: Pond Scum
donor_credits.credits: Original procedural PS1-style character geometry from the Shelf Buddies viewer, exported in the authored default model pose and scale; Lambert materials translated for glTF. Any texture is procedurally painted, not media from the photo. No viewer, staging backdrop, or original reference images included.

donor_credits.name: Shark-Jaw Stalker · Standalone Study
donor_credits.credits: Static model-only export of the explicitly delivered Shark-Jaw Stalker standalone study, using its original authored polygon geometry and solid colors. Portable PBR shading in place of the original custom renderer; excludes source reference image, controls and runtime.

license: Derivative study inherits donor provenance. No public reuse license specified for the donors; no CC0 claim.
composition: Shark side-profile upper and lower arches become a broad frontal amphibian maw. Pond Scum head/shoulder/arm/foot meshes become back armor and asymmetric-sized limbs. Furnace Beetle abdomen, mouth, carapace and ports become pressure vessels, throat, knees and ribs.
limitations: Visual study only: rigid part animation, no skinning, foot IK, colliders, gameplay, VFX or damage states.
A deliberate warm oxide/ivory/cyan material replacement unifies the low-poly donor parts; painted v2 texture donor is not used.
Donor intersections are intentional assembly joints and armor overlaps.
Jump demo is an expressive in-place preview, not an authored production locomotion or root-motion system.
